meta: At 7% interest a year, how much will you have after 10 years? The compound interest formula is confusing, but drag a slider from 1 to 30 years and watch the money grow, and you get it right away. AI can build that for you.
prompt: Build me a compound interest simulation with sliders for the amount, interest rate and number of years, plus a chart.

muc.title: Formulas are confusing
muc.text: At seven percent interest a year, how much will you have after ten years? Reading the compound interest formula, most of us get confused.

muc.title: Drag it and get it
muc.text: But with a slider, you drag the years from one to thirty and watch the bar of money grow. You get it right away, no formula needed.

muc.title: Ready in seconds
muc.text: Now you can ask AI to build that simulation in seconds. Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini can all write a small page with buttons, sliders and charts that runs right in the chat.

muc.title: Interactive simulations
muc.text: That's an interactive simulation. You don't read the result, you drag, try and see for yourself.

muc.title: Use it for all kinds of things
muc.text: Use it for all kinds of things: a family budget, a coffee shop's prices, or how a ball flies when you change the throwing angle.

muc.title: Feeling and understanding
muc.text: When it's done, ask AI: why does the curve bend upward? The simulation gives you the feeling, the explanation gives you the understanding.

muc.title: A compound interest simulation
muc.text: Message AI: build me a compound interest simulation with sliders for the amount, interest rate and number of years, plus a chart. Drag them around and see what makes your money grow fastest.

muc.title: Simulation traps
muc.text: Simulations are powerful, but they have traps too. The last part: when simulations fool you.
